dialect.detail: ACUCOBOL-GT dialect: uses ACUCOBOL-specific DISPLAY MESSAGE ... TITLE ... ICON syntax, 78-level constants, COPY .sl/.fd/.def file conventions, 'acucobol.def' copybook, and CANCEL verb for subprograms

purpose.domain_detail: Italian transport/logistics management system: daily control printout of invoiced delivery notes (bolle fatturate) for a given day
purpose.summary: This program (stt-day-p) is a subprogram that generates a daily control report of invoiced transport delivery notes ('bolle fatturate'). It reads transport, client, and carrier files, accumulates totals (number of bills and total kg), and writes a formatted sequential text report. The program is Italian-language and part of a transport management application.

notable_features: ACUCOBOL DISPLAY MESSAGE ... TITLE ... ICON GUI dialogs
DECLARATIVES with USE AFTER ERROR sections for multiple files
LINKAGE SECTION with external linkage copybook (link-stt-day.def)
File locking handling via 'geslock' subprogram CALL/CANCEL
STRING with LOW-VALUE delimiters for path construction
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
14 COPY statements for file definitions and common definitions
verdict.notes: Source is in Italian; encoded as latin-1 (contains accented characters like 'già'). The program is clearly part of a larger Italian transport/logistics application suite. Truncated at 16000 chars but the main structure is fully visible. No COMP-3 usage despite numeric totals, which is consistent with ACUCOBOL on PC platforms.
